as_converted.description: Every class converted, no preference: each share the same.

available.description: False until a class with a liquidation preference is recorded: nothing is modelled.

classes.description: Under the preferences, each class's proceeds, in the order of its name.

currency.description: The base currency every amount is in.

exit_value.description: What the shareholders receive after debts and sale costs.

examples: No share class records a liquidation preference.

modelled.description: The structures the waterfall models: the others are refused by name, never approximated.

notes.description: What the register records that the waterfall does not model.

examples: Series Seed has anti-dilution protection (broad based), and no adjustment of its conversion is recorded, so none is applied [lawyer to confirm].

on.description: The day of the register it reads.
